32397-visits-to-monasteries-in-the-levan.title: Visits To Monasteries In The Levant
32397-visits-to-monasteries-in-the-levan.creator: Unknown
32397-visits-to-monasteries-in-the-levan.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The sight of these books brought before my mind many scenes and recollections of the countries from which they came, and I said to myself, I know what I will do; I will write down some account of the most curious of these manuscripts, and the places in which they were found, as well as some of the adventures which I encountered in the pursuit of my venerable game.

arxiv-2111-12515.title: LHC EFT WG, Area 1 Electroweak input parameters
arxiv-2111-12515.creator: Editors: Ilaria Brivio, Sally Dawson, Jorge de Blas
arxiv-2111-12515.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Editors: Ilaria Brivio, Sally Dawson, Jorge de Blas. Different sets of electroweak input parameters are discussed for SMEFT predictions at the LHC. The { G μ , m Z , m W } \{G_{\mu},m_{Z},m_{W}\} one is presently recommended. \@maketitle

A discussion of the advantages and disadvantages of different sets of electroweak input parameters took place in a working-group meeting on
December 7, 2020
(see also the review on NLO predictions at the
December 14
meeting).

arxiv-2202-03929.title: Relations among topological solitons
arxiv-2202-03929.creator: Muneto Nitta
arxiv-2202-03929.description: Abstract We clarify relations among topological solitons in various dimensions: a domain wall, non-Abelian vortex, magnetic monopole and Yang-Mills instanton, together with a (non-Abelian) sine-Gordon soliton, baby Skyrmion (lump), and Skyrmion. We construct a composite configuration consisting of a domain wall, vortex, magnetic monopole and Yang-Mills instanton (wall-vortex-monopole-instanton) using the effective theory technique or moduli approximation.

arxiv-2303-02355.description: Abstract The Vera C. Rubin Observatory is expected to start the Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) in early to mid-2025 . This multi-band wide-field synoptic survey will transform our view of the solar system, with the discovery and monitoring of over 5 million small bodies.

arxiv-2308-06738.title: Probabilistic Imputation for Time-series Classification with Missing Data
arxiv-2308-06738.creator: SeungHyun Kim, Hyunsu Kim, EungGu Yun, Hwangrae Lee, Jaehun Lee, Juho Lee
arxiv-2308-06738.description: Abstract Multivariate time series data for real-world applications typically contain a significant amount of missing values. The dominant approach for classification with such missing values is to impute them heuristically with specific values (zero, mean, values of adjacent time-steps) or learnable parameters.

arxiv-2403-04088.title: The classification of endotrivial complexes
arxiv-2403-04088.creator: Sam K. Miller
arxiv-2403-04088.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sam K. Miller. Let G G be a finite group and k k a field of prime characteristic p p . We give a complete classification of endotrivial complexes, i.e. determine the Picard group ℰ k ​ ( G ) \mathcal{E}_{k}(G) of the tensor-triangulated category K b ​ ( 𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐯 k ​ G ) K^{b}({}_{kG}\mathbf{triv}) , the bounded homotopy category of p p -permutation modules, which Balmer and Gallauer recently considered in [ BG23b ] .

arxiv-2404-13146.title: DeepFake-o-meter v2.0: An Open Platform for DeepFake Detection
arxiv-2404-13146.creator: Yan Ju 1 , Chengzhe Sun 1 , Shan Jia 1† , Shuwei Hou 1 , Zhaofeng Si 1 , Soumyya Kanti Datta 1 , Lipeng Ke 2 , Riky Zhou 1 , Anita Nikolich 3 , Siwei Lyu 1
arxiv-2404-13146.description: Abstract Deepfakes, as AI-generated media, have increasingly threatened media integrity and personal privacy with realistic yet fake digital content. This work introduces an open-source and user-friendly online platform, DeepFake-O-Meter v2.0, that integrates state-of-the-art methods for detecting DeepFake images, videos, and audio. Built upon DeepFake-O-Meter v1.

pmc-10650435.title: Mitochondrial Complex I and β-Amyloid Peptide Interplay in Alzheimer’s Disease: A Critical Review of New and Old Little Regarded Findings
pmc-10650435.creator: Anna Atlante, Daniela Valenti, Bruno Imbimbo
pmc-10650435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common neurodegenerative disorder and the main cause of dementia which is characterized by a progressive cognitive decline that severely interferes with daily activities of personal life. At a pathological level, it is characterized by the accumulation of abnormal protein structures in the brain—β-amyloid (Aβ) plaques and Tau tangles—which interfere with communication between neurons and lead to their dysfunction and death.

pmc-11405760.title: Performance analysis of partially shaded high-efficiency mono PERC/mono crystalline PV module under indoor and environmental conditions
pmc-11405760.creator: Neha Kumari, Sanjay Kumar Singh, Sanjay Kumar, Vinay Kumar Jadoun
pmc-11405760.description: The ever-increasing demand for sustainable energy has drawn attention towards photovoltaic efficiency and reliability. In this context, the shading and associated hotpot degradation within PV modules has become an important area of research and development. The experimental approach of this paper aims to investigate single cell shading in high efficiency monocrystalline silicon PV PERC modules.

pmc-11443656.title: Associations between sensory impairment and functional limitations among older Chinese adults: mediating roles of social isolation and cognition
pmc-11443656.creator: Bo Xin, Yuxin He, Yixin Wu, Di Zhang, Jiaxin Liu, Shan Yang, Panpan Shi, Han Su, Wenhui Jiang
pmc-11443656.description: BackgroundThe high prevalence of sensory impairment and functional limitations in older adults is a significant concern, yet there is limited understanding of the relationship between these two conditions. Therefore, the objective of this study was to investigate the pathways connecting sensory impairment and functional limitations by examining serial multiple mediating effects of social isolation and cognition in older adults.

pmc-11487771.title: Psychometric evaluation of the Swedish version of ages and stages questionnaire social-emotional: second edition for parents of children 18 months of age
pmc-11487771.creator: Anna Edenius, Malin Bergström, Lene Lindberg, Kersti Bergqvist, Anna Fröjlinger, Pia Enebrink, Johan Åhlén
pmc-11487771.description: BackgroundSocial and emotional development are important aspects of young children’s well-being but can be difficult to assess during the first years of life. The Ages and Stages Questionnaire: Social-Emotional Second Edition (ASQ:SE-2) is a parent-rated assessment tool for child socioemotional development between 1 and 72 months of age.

pmc-11495897.title: Renal embolization for trauma: a narrative review
pmc-11495897.creator: Peter Lee, Simon Roh
pmc-11495897.description: Renal injuries commonly occur in association with blunt trauma, especially in the setting of motor vehicle accidents. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography is considered the gold-standard imaging modality to assess patients for renal injuries in the setting of blunt and penetrating trauma, and to help classify injuries based on the American Association for the Surgery of Trauma injury scoring scale.

pmc-11542494.title: Rapid Detection of SLCO1B1 Polymorphisms Using Duplex Fluorescence Melting Curve Analysis: Implications for Personalized Drug Dosing in Clinical Settings
pmc-11542494.creator: Zhikang Yu, Zifang Shang, Qingyan Huang, Heming Wu, Sandip Patil
pmc-11542494.description: ObjectiveThe polymorphism of the solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 (SLCO1B1) gene exerts a marked influence on drug transport, thus playing a pivotal role in personalized drug dosing. This study endeavours to establish a rapid, precise, and straightforward method for detecting SLCO1B1 genetic variants utilizing Duplex Fluorescence Melting Curve Analysis (DFMCA).

pmc-11636441.title: The actor‐partner interdependence model of fertility stress and marital quality among couples undergoing in vitro fertilization and embryo transfer: The mediating role of dyadic coping
pmc-11636441.creator: Xiaorun Song, Jing Zhao, Zhuoni Xiao, Hui Ye, ShiSi Dong, Lili Hu, Zhongxiang Cai
pmc-11636441.description: To explore the relationships among fertility stress, dyadic coping and marital quality in couples undergoing in vitro fertilization‐embryo transfer (IVF‐ET). Couples receiving IVF‐ET treatment at the clinic of the reproductive medicine centre of a hospital in China from February 2023 to October 2023 were selected by convenience sampling.

pmc-11710114.title: Trajectory of patients over five years in Multispecialty Interprofessional Team Memory Clinics
pmc-11710114.creator: Aaron Jones, Linda Lee, Tejal Patel
pmc-11710114.description: BackgroundMultispecialty Interprofessional Team (MINT) Memory Clinics manage dementia care in primary care, allowing for more efficient use of limited specialist resources. This study examined the characteristics of patients on their initial assessment in the MINT clinic and investigated the five‐year trajectory of patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI).

pmc-12399103.title: Unlocking the Diagnostic and Therapeutic Potential of microRNA in Diabetes: A Bibliometric and Visualized Analysis (2003–2023)
pmc-12399103.creator: Jiajing Yu, Kai Xia, Jiaming Feng, Zehui Xu, Zhuoyue Zhang, Guanyi Xiao, Huici Zhu, Wenlong Xue, Fengxi Chen, Xiaotong Xie
pmc-12399103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundMicroRNAs (miRNAs) hold considerable therapeutic potential for diabetes mellitus (DM). Over the past few decades, substantial progress has been made in miRNA-related diabetes research; however, comprehensive bibliometric analyses in this field remain limited.

pmc-12431188.title: Short-Term Forecast of Indoor CO2 Using Attention-Based LSTM: A Use Case of a Hospital in Greece
pmc-12431188.creator: Christos Mountzouris, Grigorios Protopsaltis, John Gialelis, Pier Giorgio Spazzini, Aline Piccato, Francesca Rolle
pmc-12431188.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Given the significant implications of indoor air pollution for physical and mental health, well-being and productivity, indoor air quality (IAQ) is of critical importance. CO2 is a prevalent indoor air contaminant and represents a key determinant for IAQ characterization.

pmc-12552481.title: Experimental design and analysis of toughness and modulus of rupture (MOR) of cement mortar reinforced with PET fibers
pmc-12552481.creator: Xinyu Wang, Tao Liu, Jianwei Yue, Amirehsan Teimortashlu, Mostafa Jalal, Wen Xu
pmc-12552481.description: This study examines the impact of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) fibers on major mechanical properties of cement mortar including toughness and modulus of rupture (MOR). For this purpose, various mixes were designed and PET fibers were incorporated into mortar mixes at two dosage levels (0.5% and 1% by volume), along with two other varying parameters i.e.

pmc-12703283.title: Educating healthcare students in the Sustainable Development Goals: from translational science to translational humanities
pmc-12703283.creator: Eivind Engebretsen, Trisha Greenhalgh, Paul K J Han
pmc-12703283.description: Healthcare courses typically approach Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) education from a ‘translational science’ perspective. Students are taught about ‘evidence-based’ interventions, which are developed through scientific research (hence, assumed to be politically neutral), implemented with ‘fidelity’ (ie, in a standardised way in diverse contexts) and then ‘rolled out’. Progress is measured using standardised indicators.

pmc-13263232.title: Plasma Erythropoietin Levels and Anemia in Vietnamese Patients With Type 2 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease: 2018–2019
pmc-13263232.creator: Nguyen Ngoc Anh, Đo Thi Thanh Loan, Le Viet Thang, Nguyen Thi Thuy

pmc-13436364.title: Systematic establishment of approaches to the detection of equine macrophage polarization and their application in pathogenic infection
pmc-13436364.creator: Kewei Chen, Cheng Du, Yingyi Duan, Kui Guo, Diqiu Liu, Fengxue Wang, Xiaojun Wang, Yongjun Wen
pmc-13436364.description: Macrophage phenotypic adaptation critically regulates inflammatory balance during infection; however, progress in equine immunology has been limited by a lack of specific tools for standardized identification. To address this gap, we established a reliable, antibody-based detection method for characterizing equine macrophage M1-like and M2-like marker profiles.

pmc-13518987.title: Adding flexibility to payments for environmental services enhances cost-effectiveness in the Brazilian Amazon
pmc-13518987.creator: Gabriela Demarchi, Julie Subervie, Cauê D Carrilho, Thibault Catry, Antoine Pfefer, Philippe Delacote
pmc-13518987.description: Payments for Environmental Services (PES) are widely used to protect tropical forests, but rigid pricing may fail when landowners’ opportunity costs fluctuate. Inflexible incentives can lead to contract breaches, reducing environmental benefits. We test whether flexible PES contracts improve outcomes by allowing partial payments when deforestation remains below a threshold.

pmc-13605188.title: Circulating Soluble Thrombomodulin Is Elevated in Early-Stage CKD and Is Associated with Renal Dysfunction: A Transcriptomic and Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13605188.creator: Jiao Wang, Yongfen Xiong, Chengyu Liu, Shun Wang, Wenli Wu
pmc-13605188.description: Highlights What are the main findings? THBD is enriched in renal endothelial cells and is consistently upregulated during kidney injury in both bulk and single-cell transcriptomic datasets.Circulating sTM is elevated as early as stage 1 CKD, is independently associated with renal dysfunction, and correlates with hemostatic markers. What are the implications of the main findings?
